name: Required
description: The field must not be empty.

name: Nullable
description: Marks an optional field. It does not raise an error by itself.

name: Required If
description: Requires the field when another field has a given value.

name: Email
description: The field must contain a valid email address.

name: URL
description: The field must contain a valid URL.

name: Date
description: The field must be a valid date string.

name: Letters and spaces
description: Allows letters and spaces only.

name: Letters, numbers and spaces
description: Allows letters, numbers and spaces only.

name: No spaces
description: The field must not contain spaces.

name: Regular expression
description: The value must match a complete regular-expression pattern.

name: Boolean
description: The value must be a recognized boolean-like value.

name: Numeric
description: The field must be numeric.

name: Integer
description: The field must be a whole number.

name: Minimum value
description: The numeric value must be at least the given amount.

name: Maximum value
description: The numeric value must not exceed the given amount.

name: Minimum length
description: The field must have at least the given character length.

name: Maximum length
description: The field must not exceed the given character length.

name: Match another field
description: The field must match another field.

name: Allowed values
description: The value must be one of the allowed values.

name: Blocked values
description: The value must not be one of the blocked values.

name: Unique database value
description: Checks that the value is unique in a database table.

name: Uploaded file
description: Validates that an uploaded file exists and uploaded without errors.

name: Uploaded image
description: Validates that an uploaded file is an image.
